title: What are some high quality rom-coms?

commenti.body: It is a very unusual example but my favorite would be The Lobster. Has a dark sense of humor so if your friend is not a fan of dark comedy some lighter options I recommend are The Big Sick, The Persian Version, Shortcomings, You Hurt My Feelings, Chungking Express and Midnight in Paris.

When Harry Met Sally is an all time classic. Groundhog Day is a fun formula and Bill Murray is always great. Silver Linings Playbook or La La Land are some pretty well made modern ones. 

If you want to go full classic there’s tons of great screwball comedies - His Girl Friday, Some Like It Hot, The Philadelphia Story, Bringing Up Baby, etc. But I don’t know if that’s exactly what your friend is looking for.

Not really my area of expertise, but here are some recommendations:

The Apartment 

City Lights

Some like it hot

The Princess Bride

Groundhog Day

When Harry met Sally

Sleepless in Seattle

Chungking Express

High Fidelity

If you are up for a wild ride: Love Exposure

I did not list any Woody Allen films, although he certainly made some of the best rom coms, but I can‘t separate artist and work easily.

"Starter for 10" may qualify as a romantic movie and it has its comedic moments too.

When Harry Met Sally! 

Comrades, Almost a Love Story (from Hong Kong)

I also liked "Two Night Stand"

I always go back to Crazy Stupid Love. Great ensemble, Gosling and Carell have fantastic chemistry.

500 Days of Summer.  One of the movies that sold me on JGL. 

La La Land. Great movie with or without qualifying it as a musical.

Up in the Air. Quite engaging with some unexpected turns.  

The Lost City. Unlike the previous suggestions this one is more what you think of when you hear *romcom*.  Silly, goofy, but I had fun with it.

The Wedding Singer always warms my heart and makes me laugh.

Sideways has some beautiful shots of California wine country.  And a fairly realistic look at male friendship.  Some great writing as well.  Love that bit about the life of wine.
